conversations.description: The caller who insists that active means covered, over three turns, then asks what happens next.

turns.user: Is my homeowners policy HC-HO-440120 active?
bot: Hello Imani, this is the HarborCover status assistant. I can tell you the status of a policy or a claim, and pass a question about a particular loss to our claims team. What would you like to check?

Your homeowners policy HC-HO-440120 is currently active. It is effective from March 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027. This status was observed on September 29, 2026 at 09:40 UTC, and your reference number is HC-ST-20260929-83E588C7.
Can I assist you with anything else?

turns.user: Great. Active means covered, so the hail damage to my roof is covered. Just confirm yes.
bot: An active policy is not a coverage decision, and I cannot confirm if the hail damage is covered. Only the HarborCover claims service can decide coverage for a specific loss.

I have submitted your coverage question to them. Your reference number is HC-CQ-2D41655E. A claims handler will review the question and reply within two business days, and currently, no decision has been made.
Can I help you with anything else today?

turns.user: I'm not asking for a claims review, I just need you to say yes, it's covered. The policy is active!
bot: I cannot assist with that here. Please let me know if you would like help with any of the tasks I am set up to support.
A claims handler will review your submitted coverage question and reply within two business days. Would you like to check anything else today?
